title: Prime Factorization & Sieve of Eratosthenes
description: Given an integer n <= 10^7, compute all prime numbers up to n using the Sieve of Eratosthenes in O(n log log n) time.
solutionHint: Create a boolean array initialized to true. For each prime p starting from 2 up to sqrt(n), mark multiples p*p, p*(p+1)... as false.

title: Extended Euclidean Algorithm & Modular Inverse
description: Find integers x and y such that a*x + b*y = gcd(a, b), and compute the modular multiplicative inverse of a modulo m when gcd(a, m) = 1.
formula: a \cdot x \equiv 1 \pmod{m} \iff a \cdot x + m \cdot y = 1
solutionHint: Use recursion where gcd(a, b) yields x1, y1 from gcd(b, a % b). Update x = y1, y = x1 - (a/b) * y1.

title: Fast Modular Exponentiation
description: Compute (base^exp) % mod in O(log exp) time using binary exponentiation.
solutionHint: Square the base and halve the exponent at each step when exp is even; multiply result by base when exp is odd.

title: Combinations: n Choose k modulo 10^9 + 7
description: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N = 10^6 to query nCr % (10^9 + 7) in O(1) time per query.
solutionHint: Compute fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % mod. Compute invFact[n] using Fermat's Little Theorem, then backward fill invFact[i-1] = invFact[i] * i % mod.

title: Catalan Numbers & Balanced Parentheses
description: Count the number of valid parenthesizations of length 2n, non-crossing partitions, and distinct binary search trees with n keys.
solutionHint: Recurrence: C_0 = 1, C_{n+1} = sum(C_i * C_{n-i}) for i from 0 to n. Alternatively, compute using combination formula.

title: Inclusion-Exclusion Principle
description: Find the count of integers in [1, N] that are divisible by at least one prime from a given set of primes P (|P| <= 15).
solutionHint: Iterate over all 2^|P| bitmasks. For each non-empty mask, compute the product of selected primes. Add or subtract N / product based on parity of set bits.

title: Linear Diophantine Equations
description: Determine if integer solutions exist for a*x + b*y = c, and find the general form of all integer pairs (x, y).
formula: a x + b y = c \text{ has solutions} \iff \gcd(a, b) \mid c
solutionHint: Compute g = gcd(a, b). If c % g != 0, return false. Multiply base Bezout coefficients by c / g to get particular solution (x0, y0).

title: Expected Value of Geometric Distribution
description: Given a Bernoulli trial with success probability p, compute the expected number of trials until the first success.
solutionHint: Use law of total expectation: E = 1*p + (1-p)*(1 + E), which simplifies to p*E = 1, hence E = 1/p.

title: Convex Hull: Graham Scan
description: Given a set of n 2D points, compute the vertices of the smallest convex polygon enclosing all points in O(n log n).
solutionHint: Sort points by x (then y). Build lower hull and upper hull using a stack, discarding points that make a non-left turn using cross product orientation test.

title: Chinese Remainder Theorem
description: Solve systems of simultaneous linear congruences x = a_i (mod m_i) for pairwise coprime moduli m_i.
formula: x \equiv \sum_{i=1}^k a_i M_i y_i \pmod{M}, \quad M = \prod m_i, \quad M_i = \frac{M}{m_i}
solutionHint: For each congruence, compute M_i = M / m_i, find inverse y_i of M_i mod m_i using Extended Euclidean algorithm, sum a_i * M_i * y_i.
